highlights: Background and law enforcement checks for applicants
Annual child safeguarding policy distribution and training
safety.policy_summary: UWC Thailand maintains a comprehensive Child Safeguarding Policy adhering to international standards and the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. All school employees are mandated reporters obligated to report suspected child abuse or neglect. The school conducts thorough background screenings, including law enforcement and past employer checks, for all staff applicants and reviews its safeguarding compliance annually.
